changelog: Dynamic Copilot Plan Model Fetching: Automatically queries GET https://api.githubcopilot.com/models to detect and populate only the models supported by the user's active GitHub Copilot subscription, removing invalid hardcoded models and automatically defaulting to supported models (e.g. GPT-4o)

Robust Copilot Chat & Error Diagnostics: Added detection and user-friendly error banners for unsupported models (400 modelnotsupported) and empty stream responses, with persistent error message saving so generation errors never vanish from the chat
Model Refresh & 1-Tap Sync: Added 'Refresh Plan' button in Copilot settings and bottom sheet to re-fetch plan capabilities at any time

Token-Optimized Smart Long-Running Execution: Enforced single-shot watching and non-blocking background task architecture across providers to eliminate wasteful polling loops and maximize context token efficiency
